CustomField.description: What DealOpportunityReconciliationBatch does to a deal's active protection when its primary Opportunity closes lost: No Change, Release Immediately, Release After Grace, or Require Review. "Release After Grace" and "Require Review" are both implemented as a Lifecycle_Health__c flag + audit log entry for internal follow-up in this build - full grace-period tracking and automatic delayed release are not built (see Sprint 39's Known Adaptations).
CustomField.label: Closed Lost Behaviour
